elements.text: Overture attaches this exact file. It never edits, restyles or rewrites it. Only the cover letter is written for each role, and it only says what your resume supports.
A new file applies to applications sent from now on. Applications already sent keep the version they went out with.
What Overture answers forms with, word for word. A question it cannot answer from these becomes a Review.
Confirmed before Overture began. Eight of seventeen are shown; open any fact to edit it.
Canada: authorized. United States: not authorized.
Nine more Tier 1 facts are confirmed: phone, city, country, LinkedIn, years of experience, degree, employment history, education history and languages.
Overture only scores postings that fit these.
Counted live from the postings Overture has read. Change a target and the number changes with it.
Postings that state a lower salary are skipped.
Changes apply to postings Overture finds from now on.
Companies Overture never applies to. Your current employer is on it from the start, read from your resume.
A skipped company never gets an application, even when a posting there is a Strong match. Your current employer stays on the list.
The email on every application form. Employers reply to it, and the replies appear in your Inbox.
This address. Your sign-in email is never used.
The address can only be changed through support.
